node.title: L1 raw support-ledger exponential route fence
node.statement: On the formal official-rate-half family n=2^j, k=n/2, ell=n/j, M=j/2, b=1 with j a power of two at least 16, the balanced support profile touching every petal in ell/2 points satisfies the source, list-threshold, saturation-width, and per-petal-cap arithmetic. Nevertheless the raw root-pinning right-hand side is at least 2^(n/4), while even one exact-pattern background-anchor allowance is at least q^(n/8). Hence raw support-profile summation or independent per-pattern union bounds cannot close L1; an algebraic feasibility theorem, collective cross-pattern injection, or globally paid quotient/Forney classification is necessary. No realizability or RS-list lower bound is claimed.
